_meta.description: Category codes (MCCs) consolidated from four bank documents, with each bank's treatment. Codes not in any of them are filled from the public-domain list at github.com/greggles/mcc-codes.

sources.Citi: Citi Treasury and Trade Solutions, 'Merchant Category Codes' (07/2015). Preferred source for descriptions and card networks.
sources.UOB: UOB Preferred Visa Card T&Cs, Ver 3.0, updated 10 Mar 2026. online_bonus = Selected Online Transactions category; excluded = earns no UNI$ at all.
sources.DBS: DBS 'Eligible Merchant Category Codes' (card not named in the document). Its descriptions don't always match the codes, so they are used only where no other source has the code.
sources.OCBC: OCBC 365 Card cashback T&Cs, 1 Aug 2023 (a cashback card, not in the app). bonus = cashback category; excluded = no cashback.

warnings: Bank treatments are per card and change over time; data/cards.json stays the source of truth for earning rules.
Descriptions can differ slightly between Visa and Mastercard.
